# Configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.py from src/Greenlings/Plugin.cs. Don't edit by hand. -->

All settings live in `BepInEx/config/greenlings.cfg`, which is created on first launch.
Most take effect immediately. The taming items (`[Taming] Item`, `BruteItems`), `TamedTint` and `NestScale` need a restart.

!!! warning "Multiplayer"
    Config isn't server-synced yet, so keep everyone's file the same. Server sync is on the [roadmap](../project/roadmap.md).

## Taming

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Item` | Coins | Item greylings and greydwarfs eat while being tamed (like boars eat food). |
| `BruteItems` | AmberPearl, Amber | Items brutes eat while being tamed (a coin is beneath them). |
| `ShamanItems` | Thistle | Herbs shamans eat while being tamed. |
| `TamingTime` | 600 | Seconds of being fed and calm needed to tame a greyling (boars: 1800). |
| `FedDuration` | 60 | Seconds one eaten item keeps a greyling fed (taming only progresses while fed). |
| `SearchRange` | 10 | How far greylings notice the taming item on the ground (boars notice food at 5m). |

## Visuals

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `TamedTint` | RGB 0.55, 1, 0.45 | Color multiplied onto a tamed greyling's skin. |

## Bonding

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `StartBond` | 0 | Trust (0-100) a greyling has right after taming. At 100 it can be taught. |
| `NearbyPerMinute` | 2 | Trust gained per minute while a player is nearby. |
| `NearbyRange` | 15 | How close a player must be for 'nearby' trust (meters). |
| `PatBond` | 5 | Trust gained per pat (strays). |
| `PatCooldown` | 30 | Seconds before another pat counts (any greenling). |
| `FoodBond` | 13 | Trust gained per food item (strays), handed over or eaten off the ground. |
| `FeedCooldown` | 60 | Seconds a stray stays full after eating. |
| `TagAlongTime` | 20 | Seconds a stray follows you after a pat or a meal (handy for leading it home). |
| `Foods` | Raspberry, Blueberries, Cloudberry, Mushroom, MushroomYellow, Honey, Carrot, Turnip, Onion, CookedMeat, QueensJam | Items greenlings eat: hand them over, or leave them on the ground. |

## Teaching

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Item` | Coins | Item to give a trusting greenling (use it on them) to make it watch and learn. |
| `AttentionSpan` | 90 | Seconds a greenling watches before losing interest (drains 3x when you are far away). |
| `DemoAttention` | 45 | Every step you demonstrate tops its attention back up to at least this many seconds. |
| `AttentiveAfterLesson` | 60 | Seconds after a lesson that a greenling still picks up corrections and extra steps (no new coin needed). |
| `MaxJobSteps` | 3 | How many steps one job can have (e.g. chest -> cooking station, cooking station -> chest). |
| `WatchFollowDistance` | 6 | A watching greenling follows when you are further than this. |
| `DemoWindow` | 90 | Max seconds between taking an item and putting it somewhere for it to count as a demonstration. |
| `NaturalCuriosity` | 0.012 | Chance every 2s that an idle, content greenling near you comes over to watch what you are doing. It may pick up simple chores that way. 0 disables. |
| `CasualAttention` | 45 | Seconds a naturally curious greenling watches you. |
| `UnderstandingSfx` | sfx_secretfound | Sound played with the little burst of understanding above a greenling's head (empty = none). |

## Labor

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `CarryPerTrip` | 1 | Items carried per trip. Greenlings are small: one at a time. |
| `ActionTime` | 0.7 | Seconds a greenling spends reaching in / tossing an item (plays an animation). |
| `StationReach` | 2.2 | How close a greenling must get to a station to use it. |
| `WaitRecheck` | 5 | Seconds a waiting greenling idles before checking its job again. |
| `StuckTimeout` | 30 | Seconds without reaching a target before giving up on that trip. |
| `WorkRadius` | 20 | How far a job generalizes around where it was taught: every beehive, torch, berry bush or loose item of that kind. |
| `StationGroupRadius` | 8 | Machines of the same kind this close together are worked as one bank (e.g. a row of kilns). |
| `FeedPile` | 2 | Put-it-on-the-ground jobs (feeding spots) keep this many items lying there. |
| `ChoreChance` | 0.05 | Chance every 2s that an idle (or stuck) greenling does something useful on its own: tidying, helping, chores it picked up. 0 disables. |
| `ChoreTrips` | 4 | Trips a greenling makes on a chore before wandering off again. |
| `RepairBelow` | 0.9 | Greenlings with a hammer repair pieces below this health fraction. |

## Roles

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `BrutePower` | 40 | Chop/pickaxe damage per brute whack (splitting logs, smashing rocks). |
| `GreydwarfPickables` | Pickable_Stone, Pickable_Flint, Pickable_Branch | Pickables that count as greydwarf gathering rather than greyling foraging. |

## Needs

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `MealInterval` | 900 | Seconds after eating before a greenling is hungry again. |
| `FoodSearchRange` | 20 | How far a hungry greenling looks for food lying on the ground. |
| `NestRange` | 30 | A Greenling Nest within this range counts as home. |
| `NestScale` | 0.38 | Size of the Greenling Nest relative to the vanilla vulture straw pile (needs a restart). |
| `NestCapacity` | 2 | Greenlings that fit in one nest (beds are shared out each time; nobody owns one). |
| `SleepAtNight` | true | Greenlings with a nest go to sleep in it at night. |
| `RestChance` | 0.01 | Chance every 2s that an idle greenling with a nest goes for a little rest in it (or decorates it). |
| `NestDecorations` | 4 | Plants greenlings may plant around a nest (0 = none). |
| `NestPlants` | Pickable_Dandelion, Pickable_Thistle, Pickable_Mushroom | What they plant around their nests. |
| `UnmetSlowdown` | 1.5 | Work-speed penalty multiplier per unmet need (hungry, no nest). |
| `SulkChance` | 0.15 | Chance per trip that a greenling with both needs unmet sulks for a while instead. |

## Danger

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `FearRange` | 12 | Hostile monsters this close frighten greylings: they run to you (or a brute) for protection, or just panic. |
| `ScaredTime` | 8 | Seconds a greenling stays spooked after the danger is gone (a pat calms it). |
| `RefugeRange` | 30 | How far a frightened greenling will run to reach you or a brute. |
| `OpenDoors` | true | Greenlings open (and close behind them) ordinary doors, not gates. |

## Mischief

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Chance` | 0.015 | Chance every 2s that an idle greenling gets up to something (more when needs are unmet, x2 for strays). 0 disables. |
| `MimicChance` | 0.2 | Chance an idle greenling nearby copies what you just did (copycats: much more). |
| `AudienceChance` | 0.4 | Chance an idle greenling stops to watch (or joins) another's antics. |
| `GiftPickables` | Pickable_Stone, Pickable_Flint, Pickable_Branch, Pickable_Mushroom, Pickable_Dandelion, Pickable_Thistle, RaspberryBush, BlueberryBush | Wild things a greenling may pluck to bring you as a present. |

## Shamans

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `HealRange` | 20 | How far a shaman looks for hurt tamed creatures (greenlings, your animals) to heal. |
| `HealBelow` | 0.75 | Shamans heal creatures below this health fraction. |
| `HealPercent` | 40 | Percent of the patient's max health restored per healing. |
| `HealCooldown` | 10 | Seconds a shaman needs between healings. |
| `HealPlayers` | false | Shamans heal hurt players too. |
| `SootheChance` | 0.05 | Chance every 2s that an idle shaman goes to soothe a stray nearby (builds its trust). 0 disables. |
| `SootheBond` | 6 | Trust a stray gains when a shaman soothes it. |
| `SootheCooldown` | 60 | Seconds before the same stray can be soothed again. |
| `Company` | 1 | Strays near a trusting shaman gain this times the 'nearby' trust (on top of yours, even when you are away). |
| `FieldRadius` | 12 | How far from where you planted a shaman will extend the field (only on cultivated ground). |
| `SeedsPerTrip` | 5 | Seeds a shaman carries per trip when planting. |
| `CropJitter` | 0.15 | How far (meters) a crop may land off its neat spot: rows, but planted by a greydwarf. 0 = perfect rows. |
| `CropSpacing` | 0 | Distance between crops. 0 = work it out from the plants already in the field (or the crop's own growing room). |
